items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: He came there when I was there, played for us.

ctx.x: Well, the climate wasn't as bad -- it rained a great deal, but it wasn't terribly cold. Sometimes about 3:00 in the morning you'd get sort of a tropical breeze in that part of the ocean, it's the strangest thing in the world. Almost warm, and then of course, it got never too cold really, but it snowed -- it rained most of the time.
Because when I was reading that Yehudi thing I told you about, he said --
He came there when I was there, played for us.
